title: AskLocker for Business: every bill, licence and contract, one question away
description: How a small business keeps its invoices, bills, licences and contracts in AskLocker: a supplier's bill photographed and read, a question answered with its source, renewals and bills due at a glance, reminders, and the team and CA by invitation.

chapters.title: One place for every business document

reviewNotes: Chapter times were measured from marketing/video's timeline (16:9 full cut, 91.35 s) on 3 November 2026. A changed film needs them measured again.

Re-render before publishing: the plans table (1:17) shows the numbers of 051 to 058 (₹500, ₹1,000 and ₹4,000; 4, 10, 15 and 50 people; 200 MB, 10, 25 and 100 GB; 100 questions each; a year 'one month free'). Since 066 and 067 they are ₹499, ₹999 and ₹3,999 + GST; 2, 5, 10 and 50 people; 100 MB per person, 20, 50 and 200 GB; 20 questions per person, then 1,000, 2,000 and 8,000 shared; a year about ten months. The end card says 'from ₹500'. Both are in marketing/video/src/business-screens.js (textBlocks() and BIZ.ctaNote): read the numbers from supabase/functions/_shared/plan-text.ts.
Chapter 01 says 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB': Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files are taken too since 061.
Business vaults are a pilot with a few businesses: check what the app offers before publishing (marketing/video/README.md).

To add the film: in marketing/video, node tools/render.mjs --film business && ./tools/mux.sh business-16x9, then node site/tools/add-video.mjs marketing/video/out/asklocker-business-16x9.mp4 --slug asklocker-for-business --poster-at 49.
